note: Capability source fragments the generator deliberately does not generate. A fragment whose isolated generation fails, or yields no declarations, must be listed here with a reason: scripts/discover-capability-srcs.mjs fails the build otherwise. Entries are re-validated on every run -- an exclusion whose fragment generates again, or that no longer exists in the spec, is an error, so this list cannot rot into a permanent hole.
